followUps.detail: src/mock-api/fixtures/platform.ts SUPPORT_GRANTS[0] runs 2026-09-28T07:00:00Z to 2026-12-31T15:00:00Z (about 94 days). Set expiresAt to 2026-10-12T07:00:00Z (14 days, as requested). The operations fixture already caps grant 1 at that expiry, and its fixture test accepts any platform expiry at or after the cap.

Operations contract changes: LiveEvent/LiveContract gain withheld and nullable title/supplierName, SupportGrant gains caseReference, SubscriptionRow gains commercialContactEmail, exception endpoints gain summaries, and request-body enums now return coded errors.
